questions.question: When King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem during Rehoboam's reign, what did he seize?

answers.text: The treasures of the temple and the palace
The young men of Jerusalem as captives

questions.question: King Asa of Judah did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as his forefather David had done. True or false?
What did King Asa of Judah do about his grandmother Maacah, who had made a detestable Asherah pole?

answers.text: He removed her as queen mother
He let her keep her place
He sent her away to Egypt

questions.question: King Asa of Judah sent silver and gold to King Ben-hadad of Aram. What did Asa ask him to do?

answers.text: Break his treaty with the king of Israel
Send his soldiers to guard Jerusalem
Make peace between Judah and Israel
